title: Discovering Hierarchy-Grounded Domains with Adaptive Granularity for Clinical Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2506.06977v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Domain generalization has become a critical challenge in predictive healthcare, where different patient groups exhibit shifting data distributions that degrade model performance. Still, regular domain generalization approaches often struggle in clinical settings due to (1) the absence of domain labels and (2) the lack of clinical insight integration. To address these challenges in healthcare, we aim to explore how medical ontologies can be used to discover dynamic yet hierarchy-grounded patient domains, a partitioning strategy that remains under-explored in prior work. Hence, we introduce UdonCare, a hierarchy-pruning method that iteratively divides patients into latent domains and retrieves domain-invariant (label) information from patient data. translated_title: 基于层次结构的自适应粒度域发现方法用于临床域泛化
translated_abstract: 域泛化已成为预测医疗保健领域的一个关键挑战，不同患者群体表现出数据分布的偏移，从而降低了模型性能。然而，常规的域泛化方法在临床场景中常常表现不佳，原因在于（1）缺乏域标签，以及（2）缺乏临床洞察的整合。为了应对医疗保健中的这些挑战，我们旨在探索如何利用医学本体来发现动态且基于层次结构的患者域，这是一种在以往工作中仍未被充分探索的划分策略。因此，我们提出了UdonCare，一种层次剪枝方法，它迭代地将患者划分为潜在域，并从患者数据中检索域不变的（标签）信息。在公开数据集（MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV和eICU）上，UdonCare在四项代表性临床预测任务中超越了八个泛化基线方法，展现出显著的（优势）。
tldr: 该论文提出UdonCare方法，利用医学本体通过层次剪枝迭代地将患者划分为潜在域并提取域不变信息，在多个公开临床数据集的四项临床预测任务中显著超越了八个现有域泛化基线方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes UdonCare, a hierarchy-pruning method that leverages medical ontologies to iteratively partition patients into latent domains and retrieve domain-invariant information, substantially outperforming eight existing domain generalization baselines across four clinical prediction tasks on multiple public datasets.
